name: Max in Ghostpix
storyline:
Max was a normal human boy, until the night before his ninth birthday. His father awakened his ghost powers. Then he explained to him that he was a descendant of a ghost family. Ghosts are the most clever creatures, they must keep training their brains. They have also cool powers like age changing or shape shifting!
Max loves being a ghost, but his first training day has arrived...
summary: Max in Ghostpix, also known as simply Ghostpix, is a homebrew nonogram game made by Marc Robledo for the GamePark 32 handheld console as part of the GBAX 2005 Coding Competition. It later received a full release on December of 2006, along with a port for the GP2X handheld console.
